title: [ingest] Hold-merge mode: autonomous loop builds in isolation and NEVER merges
summary: Under the heartbeat loop, every code task runs in an isolated orch/attempt/<slug> worktree, commits there, and completes as 'MERGE PENDING' — it never edits the live checkout, never merges to main, and never calls request_guidance mid-run. Merges/conflicts/failures are all queued for human morning review via the verdict. Merging to main is a human decision.
